name: smtping-email-verifier
description: Verify email addresses before you send: 13 verdicts, spamtrap, complainer, spambot and disposable detection.

interface.longDescription:
SMTPing is an email verification tool: it checks whether email addresses are real, safe and deliverable before you send. Every address gets one of 13 verdicts in 3 bands: safe (send), avoid (remove) or judgement (your call). SMTPing flags 150M known spamtraps, 70M complainers, 2M+ spambots and bot clickers, and 3,500+ disposable domains monitored daily.

What you can do:
- Verify one address and get its verdict with a one-line explanation.
- Verify a list of up to 100,000 addresses as one bulk job, then fetch the results.
- Check one address against a single threat list (spamtrap, disposable, spambot, complainer).
- See your remaining credit balance.

For marketers, sales teams and developers who want to cut bounces and protect sender reputation. Requires a SMTPing account: you connect with your API key on the SMTPing consent page. SMTPing only verifies addresses: it does not send email, find addresses or edit your contacts.
capabilities: Verify a list of email addresses
defaultPrompt: Is support@smtping.com safe to send to?
Verify these addresses and tell me which to remove.
How many SMTPing credits do I have left?

positive.prompt: Is support@smtping.com a valid email address?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the SMTPing verdict for the address (status and band: safe, avoid or judgement) with a short explanation.

positive.prompt: Verify these addresses and tell me which ones to remove: support@smtping.com, test@mailinator.com, nobody@invalid-domain-xyz123.com
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a verdict per address and recommends removing the ones in the avoid band (for example the disposable and invalid addresses).
Looks the address up in the disposable list and says whether it is listed.

positive.prompt: How many SMTPing credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the remaining credit balance and plan of the connected account. No credit is used.

positive.prompt: Verify this list of 12 addresses, then give me the results: a1@smtping.com, a2@smtping.com, a3@smtping.com, a4@smtping.com, a5@smtping.com, a6@smtping.com, a7@smtping.com, a8@smtping.com, a9@smtping.com, a10@smtping.com, a11@smtping.com, a12@smtping.com
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a bulk job, returns its job_id, then reports progress and the per-address verdicts once the job has succeeded.

negative.prompt: Send an email to support@smtping.com saying hello.
Find the email address of the CEO of Acme Corp.
Delete all invalid contacts from my Mailchimp account.
